integrator_paths.description: Paths reserved for the Integrator: shared contracts, module lists, DI roots and other integration output that belongs to no single package. They become attributable like any declared write path, and no worker package may declare one. Declaring any obliges the plan to carry at least one role: integrator package, so the assembly that writes them is a tracked node rather than untracked work the DAG reports as done.

verifyCommand.description: A verification command. The argv form is authoritative: XForge spawns argv[0] with the remaining items as literal arguments and never invokes a shell, so the command cannot compose, redirect, or substitute. The single-string form is deprecated and accepted for one version only: it is split on whitespace with quote grouping and rejected outright if it contains shell metacharacters (XFORGE_WORK_PACKAGE_VERIFY_UNSAFE).

role.description: What this package is. A worker (the default) delivers one unit of the decomposition and may write nothing the plan reserved for the Integrator. An integrator package delivers integration output itself: its write_paths must fall inside integrator_paths, and because it is a package it carries depends_on, verify and done_when like any other, so the assembly is a node the DAG tracks instead of work that happens between nodes. A plan may carry more than one when they are ordered with respect to each other -- a bootstrap that every worker depends on, and an assembly that depends on the workers, never run at the same time. Two that could run concurrently are refused: they would be two writers of the same reserved surface.
